title: Resolution declaring July 28 World Hepatitis Day in NYC
summary: This resolution would declare July 28 as World Hepatitis Day in New York City to promote prevention, vaccination, testing and access to care. It cites a 2024 Health Department report showing thousands of New Yorkers diagnosed with acute and chronic hepatitis B and C. The resolution also recognizes healthcare providers and community organizations working to reduce the disease's impact on the city.
